entries.title: Right-click a full screen picture to copy or save it
entries.body: A right-click on a picture you opened from a card now shows a menu where you clicked. Copy picture puts it on the clipboard at its own size, ready to paste into any app or a message. Save to Downloads keeps its own file, named for the card. The menu also holds Actual size and Point at, and ⌘C and ⌘S work without it.

picture.alt: A full screen card picture with its menu open at the pointer: Copy picture, Save to Downloads, Actual size and Point at, each with its key
